name: BDC_LLM_APPEAL_HISTORY
description: The LLM generation history for the BDC.

columns.name: BDC_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the den/corr rec record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: RUN_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The UTC instant when the event happened.

columns.name: RUN_ID_KEY
columns.description: The run ID from the associated LLM record corresponding to this run.

columns.name: EXCLUDED_YN
columns.description: Whether the BDC was excluded from LLM generation.

columns.name: LLM_APPEAL_TRIGGER_C_NAME
columns.description: The system trigger that resulted in attempting to generate LLM text at this point in time.
